newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria Unionbank posts 216 mln lev 1996 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria Unionbank posts 216 mln lev 1996 net profit.

text.p: Bulgaria's private Unionbank said it posted a 215.8 million levs net profit for 1996, up from 154.4 million levs net profit in 1995.
The bank would raise its capital to 2.77 billion levs, the bank's executive director Ivan Radev said.
Some 10 million of the net would be distributed as a three percent dividend to non-voting shareholders, Radev said.
"Unionbank posted 215.8 million levs net-profit for 1996 fromfrom current 990 million a net income worth 5.2 billion levs after setting aside provisions and paying taxes," he told a news conference.
The bank's provisions amounted to 4.5 billion levs at the end of 1996.
The bank's annual shareholders meeting on Saturday decided to raise capital to 2.77 billion levs from current 990 million levs, Radev said.
To fund the increase the bank said it would transfer some 206 million levs of the net into share capital and will also transfer 1.6 billion levs of reserves.
Unionbank, which has a one-tier management system and a full banking licence, was launched as a successor to Sofia Financial House in late 1994.
